# bugs #4034: stm8: SIGSEGV in the DWARF writer for --c1mode with --debug and --out-fmt-elf

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/4034/
- Category: [Analyzed, not fixed](../../unresolved.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17158
- Recommended action: Keep open. Decide what --debug does in --c1mode, then open the debug file there or add a test to the DWARF writer.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

With sdcc r17158 for stm8, a source file on standard input with `--c1mode --debug --out-fmt-elf`
ends in SIGSEGV during code generation, as the ticket reports. `--c1mode` alone and
`--c1mode --debug` exit normally. mcs51 does not have the defect. With each of the three option
sets, sdcc for mcs51 exits with status 0 and writes the assembly.

## Known

`parseCmdLine` in `src/SDCCmain.c` opens the debug file and writes the module record under the
condition `options.debug && fullSrcFileName`, and `--c1mode` sets `fullSrcFileName` to NULL.
`dwOpenFile` and `dwWriteModule` in `src/SDCCdwarf2.c` are therefore not called. `dwTypeTagTable`
and `dwRootTag` stay NULL, and `dwWriteFunction` dereferences them for the first function.

`--out-fmt-elf` selects the DWARF writer in the stm8, hc08, s08, and pdk ports. Only stm8 was run.
mcs51 does not have the option, and sdcc gives warning 117 for it. mcs51 keeps the CDB writer in
`src/cdbFile.c`, whose functions return when no debug file is open.

The same condition has another effect on mcs51. With `--debug --c1mode` sdcc writes no `.adb`
file, and the assembly has debug symbols for the data only. For one source file it has 4 debug
symbol definitions and no C-line symbols. The same file compiled by name with `-S` gives 21 and
13.

## Open

Opening the debug file in c1 mode would remove the crash and give mcs51 its debug symbols. This was
not tried. It changes the output of every port in c1 mode, because a `.adb` file appears next to
the output file. `dwWriteModule` also passes `fullSrcFileName` as `DW_AT_name`, so the DWARF
writer needs another name in c1 mode. A test for an open file in the DWARF writer, like the one in
the CDB writer, would remove the crash only.
